svg.title: eddy: a program lists meetings, a session reads them later
svg.desc: Three meeting services, Wispr Flow, Webex and Microsoft Teams, hold recorded meetings. eddy has one part per service. Each part lists its service's meetings and fetches them while the count of model calls stays at zero, and a two-minute check-in is skipped as too short to matter. eddy keeps each other meeting under its key, meeting slash service slash the meeting's id, with the transcript as the service served it and a plain copy with one line per turn. Later, and outside eddy, a Claude session reads one transcript and writes signals through millpond.
svg.text: lists recorded meetings; a session reads them later

g.text: too short to matter is skipped.
Each is kept by its key,
